name: hyprland-virtual-desktops
label: Virtual Desktops Manager
description: Provides named 2D grid virtual desktops, workspace matrices, and window sticky rules across monitors.

options.label: Desktop Names List
options.description: Comma-separated list of named virtual desktops (e.g. 'Main, Web, Code, Chat').

options.label: Grid Rows
options.description: Number of vertical desktop rows in 2D navigation grid.

options.label: Grid Columns
options.description: Number of horizontal desktop columns in 2D navigation grid.

options.label: Remember Layout Per Desktop
options.description: Preserve tiling vs floating layouts independently per virtual desktop.

options.label: Notify On Switch
options.description: Display desktop name notification when changing virtual desktops.
